findings.title: Antigravity ACP environment cannot display PNG images in model visual context
findings.detail: Direct calls to view_file and client_view_file on PNG paths return lossy UTF-8 replacement text ('\ufffdPNG...'), and MCP image/png responses from t3-code are offloaded to disk paths by the ACP host. findings.title: Unchecked Appearance theme card outer border uses decorative --line-strong (2.28:1 light / 2.09:1 dark) while inner radio and text exceed AAA
findings.detail: Evaluated as a whole control per ky-ui reviews/AGENTS.md, each unchecked .ky-appearance-option card has high-contrast label text (16.06:1 light / 13.99:1 dark), a 48px swatch preview, and a 16x16 native radio button with a high-contrast border (16.06:1 light / 12.67:1 dark), while the checked card has a 4.93:1 (light) / 6.47:1 (dark) accent border+outline. If outer card borders on unchecked tiles are desired to meet 3:1 non-text contrast independently of the inner radio control, switching .ky-appearance-option border from --line-strong to --ky-field-border would raise the outer card border to ~4.5:1.
